title: The embed quickstart describes the safe cross-origin (CORS) pattern and warns against reflected-origin + credentials

criteria.then: it states Saiku ships no CORS configuration and that the embed preflights because of the X-Saiku-Embed-Token header
it gives the safe pattern: an explicit origin allowlist, scoped to the guest embed prefixes only, with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials never enabled
it warns explicitly against reflecting the Origin header together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true on /rest/**
the old claim that there are no CORS complications is gone
